newsitem.title: FINLAND: PARTEK SAYS ITS NORDKALK BUYS SWEDISH FIRM.
newsitem.headline: PARTEK SAYS ITS NORDKALK BUYS SWEDISH FIRM.

text.p: Finnish cargo handling equipment and construction material group Partek Oy Ab said on Friday its Nordkalk unit will buy Swedish limestone company All-Kalk for an undisclosed sum.
"The acquisition of All-Kalk is in line with Nordkalk's strategy to strengthen its position in the Baltic Sea region as the leading producer of limestone based products," Partek said in a statement.

All-Kalk quarries and refines limestone for use in agriculture and the feed industry with 50,000 tonnes annual output, which will raise Nordkalk's production of carbonate products in Sweden by 10 percent, it said.
